mobbin.title: Spotify listening history
mobbin.observed: Dark canvas, fine concentric record outlines, large negative space and one dated listening result.
mobbin.used: A restrained record-line motif beside the journal introduction; actual listening data remains the focal point.

mobbin.title: timespent activity sessions
mobbin.observed: Plain ruled session rows pair subdued dates with bold right-aligned elapsed durations.
mobbin.used: Prominent tabular counted time with quieter qualification threshold and no extrapolated playback clock.

mobbin.title: Headspace activity history
mobbin.observed: A thin vertical timeline separates dated sections while title, content identity and duration remain immediately legible.
mobbin.used: Left-aligned receipt and queued-listen rows, clear status symbols, track identity before incidental metadata.

primary.used: Public username reading is separate from token-authenticated writing. Validate the token and returned account; submit after half a song or four minutes; scoped playing-now deletion clears only this client's notice.
Playing-now is temporary and lacks listened_at. Permanent submissions use the first-heard timestamp. Keep retry payload metadata and timestamps stable.
Link to the official user-token settings page and keep authentication in headers, separate from public reader configuration.

scope: Native service connection and listening journal; this unit introduces no new wall canvas. Existing now-playing artwork remains the wall composition.
